description: Saves tokens and API keys as environment variables (stored encrypted) and re-publishes so the app picks them up. Values are never returned back. Ask the user for them.

file.description: Which env file to write to; ".env" unless the project uses another

publish.description: Re-publish right away so the running app receives the new values

secrets.description: Secrets as {"BOT_TOKEN": "123:abc"}. Stored encrypted; delivered to the app as environment variables via .env. Ask the user for values — never invent them.

name: netrun_set_secrets
title: Set project secrets
